responses.text: I understand.

dynamic_line: He gives his appetites the name of freedom. The people made to suffer for them have no freedom at all. Do not let his strength persuade you that cruelty is inevitable.

responses.text: I understand.

dynamic_line: A refuge must allow someone to leave it. When every promise of safety demands that you surrender your voice, ask whose peace is really being protected.

responses.text: I understand.

dynamic_line: A sworn duty does not take away the hand that carries it out. Armor may protect its bearer, but it cannot answer for what he chooses to crush beneath it.

responses.text: I understand.

dynamic_line: A fallen creature cannot strike again. But the wound through which it reached us may remain. Examine what is left at the place; closing that wound is a separate task.

responses.text: Another question.
